author.name: George R. R. Martin
author.heading: About George R. R. Martin
author.bio: George R. R. Martin is the author of A Song of Ice and Fire and has also worked as a television writer and producer. His official biography describes early magazine fiction, work on The Twilight Zone and Beauty and the Beast, and a transition to full-time writing in 1979. His career spans prose fantasy and screen storytelling, the background relevant to this remark about artistic decisions.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Martin has worked in both fiction publishing and television production, where the relationship between a writer’s story and audience expectations is a practical concern. The cited sentence rejects deciding an ending by vote, but the unavailable original prevents reconstructing the interviewer’s exact question or assigning the remark to a specific modern fan controversy.
